description: nhflow_3d_mb_breaking with the breaking filter (A 552 3): the filtered water level exchanged between the level-0 grids after the filter (nhflow_amr::brk_exchange0). The filter sweeps (Gauss-Seidel) depend on the order of the cells, so the blocks differ from one block as a cut into ranks does: 4e-3 m after 0.2 s, one block on 2 ranks with the bore at the rank boundary 4e-3 m (validation/11_block_kennedy_filter).
